en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide cobblestone square with children playing in the foreground and people walking or riding carts in the mid‑ground. On the left, there is a row of multi‑story traditional Galician houses with arcades and enclosed glass balconies. On the right stands a church with a tall bell tower and adjacent buildings, as well as leafless trees aligned along the square. The caption at the bottom reads "BETANZOS. PLAZA DE ARINES." and in the lower right corner appears the printer's mark "PERRER – CORUÑA". The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century Spanish town scene.
